node.statement: Dependency bridge and exact limitation. Let H_c be the additional premise that c_0^cb is a fixed finite nonnegative universal constant. From H_c and node 1.1, obtain K_1,e_call_1 and t_1 with all threshold and coefficient inequalities. Combine these inequalities with the component constructions of nodes 1.2, 1.3, and 1.4; every raw-refinement antecedent is then bounded by t_1<=e_1, and the explicit fields listed in node 1.5 form the required def-maincb-raw-call datum. Thus nodes 1.1-1.4 imply the packaging claim only under H_c. Since no allowed input proves H_c, modus ponens cannot eliminate H_c, and no unconditional dependency path from the permitted inputs to node 1.5 or root node 1 exists in this workspace.
